retrieval_policy.rate_limit_policy: respect WHO API terms and documented service limits; do not retry indefinitely
retrieval_policy.probe_scope: one authoritative record after explicit credential and payload-handling approval

normalization_contract.identifier: preserve WHO entity URI and distinguish foundation URI from MMS linearization URI
normalization_contract.code: retain MMS code only when returned by a linearization endpoint
normalization_contract.preferred_label: store only in local or approved derived artifacts after terms gate
normalization_contract.synonyms: store only in local or approved derived artifacts after terms gate
normalization_contract.language: normalize Accept-Language and returned language tags to ISO 639-1
normalization_contract.candidate_policy: all HPO crosswalk or LLM-assisted outputs remain candidate-only; agent_panel_assessment_required and maintainer_promotion_decision_required
